recipes.name: Double Chocolate Granola
instructions: Line a baking tray and preheat the oven to 340°F (170°C)*.
Add all the dry ingredients to a food processor. Pulse to roughly chop the oats and nuts**.
Remove the blades from the food processor. If the blades can't be removed, transfer the contents to a large bowl instead. Add the maple syrup, coconut oil, and vanilla and mix using a rubber spatula.
Transfer the mixture to the baking tray and spread it out evenly. Let the granola bake in the oven on the centre rack for 20 to 22 minutes, stirring halfway to ensure even baking.
Remove from the oven and allow the granola to cool completely. It will harden as it cools. Once completely cool, mix in the chocolate chunks, and enjoy with milk or yogurt and fresh fruit.

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Refined coconut oil is coconut oil that doesn't smell or taste like coconuts. If you prefer a distinct coconut taste, use unrefined coconut oil instead. † We use 50 - 60% cocoa chocolate for a balanced sweetness. Darker varieties (70%+) can make the result too bitter. * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection). ** If you don't have a food processor, you can also coarsely chop the nuts and seeds with a knife.
Storage Store the granola in an airtight container or large glass storage jar in a cool and dry place for up to 3 weeks.
